verdict.rationale: OpenTofu documents a `tofu import` command that brings existing resources into OpenTofu state by ID and address. A community comment also mentions import blocks supporting for_each. Nothing in the evidence shows OpenTofu generating matching configuration code for imported resources, so only half the story is delivered. Missing for 10: documented configuration-code generation for imported resources, first-party docs on import blocks, and hands-on corroboration of the import workflow.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can import existing cloud resources under management and generate matching configuration code

citations.quote: The `tofu import` command imports existing resources into OpenTofu.
Import will find the existing resource from ID and import it into your OpenTofu state at the given ADDRESS.
